messages.bad_index: no buff with this number, see /sbt list
messages.list_empty: no buffs yet, add one with /sbt add
messages.add_usage: /sbt add <buff> [= spell|item <name, id or link>]; <buff> -- a spell name, id or link, or mainhand / offhand for a weapon enchant
messages.unknown_target: the buff is a spell (name, id or link) or mainhand / offhand, not an item
messages.unknown_source_kind: after = write spell or item, then a name, id or link
messages.unknown_item: unknown item: put it into the bags or give its id or link (shift-click)
messages.in_combat: not in combat: the panel can change only out of combat
messages.unlocked: the panel is unlocked: drag it, then /sbt lock
messages.warn_set: a buff with %d seconds left or less counts as missing
messages.minimap_hidden: the minimap button is hidden, /sbt minimap brings it back
messages.unknown_icon: no picture found: give a spell id, or shift-click a spell, an item or a buff

add.help: <buff> [= spell|item <source>] -- track a buff; with a source a click puts it back

remove.help: <number> -- stop tracking a buff (numbers from /sbt list)

mode.help: [all|missing] -- all buffs with timers or only the missing ones

unlock.help: unlock the panel to drag it

warn.help: <seconds> -- a buff running out this soon counts as missing

move.help: unlock the panel to drag it, or lock it

debug.help: what the addon sees on you now (to send a screenshot)

minimap.no_library: no LibDBIcon: the minimap button is off

settings.warn_seconds: Show a buff this long before it runs out
settings.locked_hint: Unchecked: a green frame covers the panel, drag it with the left mouse button. Not in combat.
settings.no_buff_chosen: Add a buff or pick one on the left
settings.aura_note: Name or spell id. Suggests your spells and every buff you have had on you. Shift-click or drag a spell here.
settings.spell_note: Drag a spell from the spellbook here, or shift-click it while this field is in focus.
settings.item_note: Drag an item from the bags here, or shift-click it in the bags while this field is in focus.
settings.icon_note: Empty: the buff's own picture. Suggests your spells, bag items and buffs you have had. Drag or shift-click works too.
settings.add_note: Drag a buff to change the order. Shift-click a buff of yours (top right) to add it.
settings.enchant_note: The enchants seen on your weapons. Not in the list? Put it on once (oil, Flametongue...).
